title: Toward or away? A six-item self-check
instructions: Answer for the last two weeks. There are no right answers; this is a snapshot for you and David to look at together.

items.text: When my partner is upset, I move closer rather than pull back.
I can say what I want without turning it into a criticism.
I can hear my partner's hurt without defending myself.
After a fight, one of us reaches out to repair within a day.
I tell my partner something I appreciate about them.
I feel like myself when I am with my partner.
